evidence.summary: Official metadata publishes NLSC national/provincial road centerlines, lists road-number and road-name fields, links downloadable resources, and assigns OGDL 1.0.
OGDL 1.0 permits reproduction, distribution, compilation, adaptation, and sublicensing, with explicit attribution required.

blockers: RoadAuthorizationStore exposes only the single frozen ROAD-03 authorization ID.
FrozenRoadAuthorizationVerifier requires the historical archive, fixture, proposal, decision, approval, authorization, segment, class, route, and portrayal identities.
The ROAD-03 issuer builds only the historical bindings; it cannot issue a capability for a new fixture.
The generic GEN adapter boundary cannot issue domain authorization or execute domain payloads.

domain_decisions.source_answer: Officially licensed school sources exist, but no candidate establishes the six source layers, schema bindings, 15 Point features, and provenance relationships required by the frozen executor.
domain_decisions.authority_answer: OGDL publication authority can be established for the candidates, but the repository has only a School authorization consumer/verifier and test-only constructors; no domain-owned issuer establishes new demo execution authority.
domain_decisions.architecture_answer: A compatible public School fixture would require false source-layer relabeling or a post-freeze profile/authorization change, both forbidden here.

domain_decisions.source_answer: An officially licensed LineString road-centerline source exists and could support a future demo fixture, but not the immutable ROAD-04 execution path.
domain_decisions.authority_answer: OGDL publication authority can be established for the candidate; no new ROAD demo authorization can be issued because the frozen issuer and verifier bind only the historical ROAD identities.
domain_decisions.architecture_answer: The frozen executor cannot accept a different archive, fixture, segment set, route, class, or authorization identity without a post-freeze ROAD contract and implementation change.
